name: AirTrunk SYD1 Sydney West (phases 3-4)

address.note: phases 3-4 assumed on the original lot: the JRPP DA's 8 stages cover this lot, and the only other SYD1 building DA (24 Healey Circuit, 2020) is recorded as airtrunk-syd1-healey

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '35 Huntingwood Drive, Huntingwood NSW 2148' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Address point for the whole 35 Huntingwood Drive lot, not this phase's building footprint (building position within the lot not known).

builder.note: phase 4 only: A W Edwards project page 'AirTrunk SYD1 Phase 4 Data Centre', 'Design and Construction of a two-storey data centre, inclusive of all services and fitout of data halls, office areas and external works' (D&C). Phase 3 head contractor not confirmed; a 'Phase 3B' formwork job is listed by Transform Formwork (source 5, page offline) and beyondfire lists AW Edwards as builder for SYD1 generally (source 6)

mw_it.note: ESTIMATE, derived, no source states it: campus 130+ MW (source 7) minus phase 1 20 MW, phase 2 10 MW and final (fifth-building) phase 40+ MW (source 9) = ~60 MW; both 130 and 40 are '+' figures so approximate. Alternative: 2017 plan of '80MW' for the original site (sources 2, 3) minus 30 MW = 50 MW. Grouped row: sources give no MW or dates for phase 3 and phase 4 separately, so no split is invented

cost_aud_m.note: no phase-level cost found. DA JRPP-16-03318 CIV $47,529,862 covers all 8 stages on 35 Huntingwood Drive incl. phase 1 (source 1); not apportioned

authority.value: Sydney West Joint Regional Planning Panel (assessed by Blacktown City Council)

pathway.value: Development application (regional development, JRPP determination), EP&A Act 1979
pathway.note: inferred: 35 Huntingwood Drive build-out under 8-stage consent JRPP-16-03318 (8 data-hall stages, 23,080 sqm data hall GFA). No separate DA or modification found; the architect's (DEM) figures of 25,880 sqm GFA / 16 data halls (source 10) differ from the DA's, so modifications are possible

construction_end.note: not found.
